stage0085b_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$アマタ$$, where do you think you're going!?」

stage0085b_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$モロイ$$
「This is bad, $$カイエン$$!
　$$ミコノ$$ and $$ゼシカ$$ went off somewhere alone too!」

stage0085b_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「We don't even know where the Mythical Aquarion is...
　What in the world is happening!?」

stage0085b_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$アリシア$$
「I've been waiting for you... all this time」

stage0085b_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$アリシア$$
「That's right...
　After I came to Altair, I kept myself asleep
　to protect myself from Eve's curse」

stage0085b_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$アリシア$$
「But then he... woke me up...
　before the final battle」

stage0085b_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$アリシア$$
「$$アマタ$$, I finally get to see you...
　You've grown so much...」

stage0085b_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What now, after all this time...!
　You left me behind...!」

stage0085b_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Do you have any idea what it's been like for me!?
　And now, after all this, you call out to me...!」

stage0085b_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$アリシア$$
「$$アマタ$$...
　I won't ask you to forgive me」

stage0085b_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アリシア$$
「But please... I want you to know.
　Why I left you behind...
　and about your father...」

stage0085b_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アリシア$$
「Your father isn't from Earth.
　$$イズモ・カムロギ$$... Supreme Commander of Altair」

stage0085b_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$アリシア$$
「Your father came to our Earth on a mission
　to bring back a woman who could withstand dimensional transfer.
　This was back when I was still an actress」

stage0085b_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$アリシア$$
「I met your father after he made an emergency landing from a system failure.
　And as he spent time with me,
　he realized I was the $$レア・イグラー$$ Altair was looking for...」

stage0085b_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$アリシア$$
「But in even less time than that,
　we fell for each other...」

stage0085b_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$アリシア$$
「Your father hid my existence, at least at first,
　and returned to Altair.
　But he couldn't fool that man $$ミカゲ$$」

stage0085b_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アリシア$$
「A few years later, when he appeared again,
　you were already there」

stage0085b_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Did that guy try to drag you to Altair
　against your will?」

stage0085b_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Then you decided to go to Altair on your own!
　Even knowing about Eve's curse!」

stage0085b_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アリシア$$
「I agonized for so long over whether to take you to Altair...
　But my fear of putting you in danger
　on an unknown planet was greater」

stage0085b_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アリシア$$
「I never imagined it would be such a long parting...」

stage0085b_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アリシア$$
「No... however I dress it up in words,
　there's no denying I abandoned you」

stage0085b_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$アリシア$$
「I wanted to save the planet of the man I loved.
　The thing he loved most...」

stage0085b_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アマタ$$
「...I resented you for so long.
　But not anymore...」

stage0085b_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What I hate is myself back then,
　who could only watch you go...」

stage0085b_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You had the courage to chase after the one you loved,
　and I didn't...
　That's all it comes down to, Mom」

stage0085b_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Let me thank you as well」

stage0085b_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「$$アリシア$$...
　I want to meet my end with you」

stage0085b_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I heard about you from Mom」

stage0085b_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$イズモ$$
「...I have no words to ask your forgiveness...
　I took your mother from you... I...」

stage0085b_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Impossible...
　Every natural living creature on Iron-C
　should have died out」

stage0085b_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Kagerou...
　I saw one, just once, when I was young...」

stage0085b_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$イズモ$$
「The females vanished, and they should have gone extinct long ago...
　Why, after all this time...」

stage0085b_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「This is Area 337...
　where trouble kept flaring up on Iron-C...
　Don't tell me Iron-C itself is...!」

stage0085b_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Woman and man, yin and yang. Only with both poles
　is the order of all creation maintained... he said」

stage0085b_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Mother Earth, the goddess of the land...
　The land that brings forth abundance is a symbol of womanhood...」

stage0085b_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$イズモ$$
「And Iron-C is a system that draws energy
　from the planet's land...」

stage0085b_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$イズモ$$
「But perhaps, at the same time, it was stealing away
　the planet's maternal power...」

stage0085b_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So that's... the cause of Eve's curse...」

stage0085b_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Iron-C is the root of it all...
　Was my entire life for nothing...」

stage0085b_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Stay with me!
　We just found each other!
　Dad...! Dad!!」

stage0085b_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$アリシア$$
「Your life was never for nothing.
　After all, you left $$アマタ$$ in this world.
　This child will surely... the two worlds...」

stage0085b_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$アリシア$$
「$$アマタ$$...
　You are the proof of our love...」

stage0085b_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アリシア$$
「$$アマタ$$, you too, love someone.
　Someone more precious to you than anyone else...」

stage0085b_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Farewell, $$アマタ$$...
　To you... I entrust... the future of both worlds.........」

stage0085b_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$シュレード$$...
　The ultimate melody, proof that you lived...
　I too have surely heard it」

stage0085b_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And your days of battle have become
　300 Z-Chips.
　I'll add these to the squad's stock」

stage0085b_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For now, I can only pray for your soul to rest in peace...」

stage0085b_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Sorry about that!
　Since things are quite hectic right now,
　I'll have D-Trader run on the auto-system!」

stage0085b_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The celebration for the ace pilot will have to wait for next time!」

stage0085b_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then!
　Even in the middle of battle, let's get to it... business, business!」
